hooks.command: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const f=p.join(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||process.cwd(),'docs','STATUS.md');const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SessionStart',additionalContext:'Project status, read from docs/STATUS.md at session start:\n\n'+s}}))}catch(e){}"
